KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.

2. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.

3. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   C. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.

4. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.

5. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. watoto
   C. mato
   D. kitoto

6. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

7. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

8. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

9. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

10. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain miezi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
